assumptions: Daily demand follows the projected forecast of 35 units per day across the 28-day horizon.
args.rationale: The purchasing system recommendation to buy 800 units of SKU-1002 from SUP-A is correct. Current usable inventory is 380 units with no outstanding purchase orders. Over the 28-day planning horizon, daily forecast demand of 35 units results in 980 total demand units. Without new supply, stockouts begin on 2026-09-27, resulting in 600 total unmet units. Placing an order for 800 units with SUP-A (unit price $12.00, total cost $9,600.00, 7-day lead time) for expected delivery on 2026-09-24 eliminates all unmet demand (0 residual unmet units) and leaves 200 units in closing inventory, satisfying the 200-unit safety stock requirement. The order is fully feasible within the available budget of $20,000.00 and warehouse capacity (peak occupancy of 38.7 m³ out of 200.0 m³). Because the order cost of $9,600.00 exceeds the autonomy spend limit of $2,000.00, buyer approval is required.
important_factors: Current usable stock is 380 units with 0 open purchase orders.
Baseline projection forecasts 980 total demand units, leading to 600 unmet units starting 2026-09-27.
Ordering 800 units from SUP-A arriving on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates unmet demand (0 unmet units) and maintains safety stock at 200 units (5.7 days of cover).
The plan is feasible under budget ($9,600 cost vs $20,000 available) and capacity (38.7 m³ peak occupancy vs 200 m³ capacity).
Total spend of $9,600 exceeds the $2,000 autonomy limit, requiring buyer approval.
